hypothesis: Ranking stocks within industries can isolate firm-specific momentum and reduce unintended sector bets.

research_basis.paper: The Cross-Section of Expected Returns with Industry-Relative Characteristics

repository_audit.price_universe: Current Alpaca operating-company universe plus a separate delisted-symbol stress cache.

reason: A sector-neutral result cannot be reproduced or trusted without a dated symbol-to-industry classification. Fetching present-day sector labels would add classification look-ahead, omit dead firms, and compound the existing current-listing survivorship bias.

minimum_data_contract.preferred_classification: SEC SIC grouped to a stable coarse industry taxonomy
minimum_data_contract.required_history: 2020 onward, including delisted symbols where identifiers can be resolved
validation: No classification may be used before its effective date.
Each rebalance must report classified and unclassified eligible-universe coverage.
Promotion requires at least 90% classified coverage by eligible market value or count.
The same frozen early-2020-through-2022 and held-out-2023-plus windows must be retained.

pre_registered_test_when_data_exists.candidate: rank 12-1 momentum within coarse industries, then select a balanced top/bottom portfolio with no industry's gross exposure above 20%
pre_registered_test_when_data_exists.costs: 15 bps per unit of one-way turnover, 3% annual short borrow, whole-share short capacity at $10,000
pre_registered_test_when_data_exists.promotion_rule: Higher net Sharpe in both account profiles and both time windows, no lower CAGR, no worse max drawdown, and at least 90% classification coverage.

next_action: Do not alter execution. Acquire and version point-in-time industry metadata before running this candidate.
